name: This World Belongs to the Villainess
source:
Seraphina believes humanity is beyond saving. After witnessing the harsh cruelty of a world governed by free will, she seeks to clean the slate, harnessing the power of the stars to reshape reality. She travels across the realm in search of what she needs to cast her spell, but she quickly draws trouble, and at every turn, she crosses paths with another naive hero determined to stop her.

Instead of giving up, however, Seraphina plans to use them to her advantage. Will she succeed in dragging a hero to Corruption, succumb to the healing power of Redemption, or stumble down a path that leads to her Defeat?
